Hello Francesco,

I'm sorry. Three times now you've set aside the time, joined on time, and nobody opened the room. That's entirely on us.

I can't issue the thank-you compensation myself, so I've put this in front of Abel and Georges directly, with the amount you were told and the fact that today's call went the same way as the two before it. They're on now and a colleague is picking it up today, and you'll get their answer as a reply in this thread.

I've asked them to come back with a slot that works in Italian time as well, so the interview actually happens if you still want to do it.

Thanks for staying patient with us on this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
